'''Upell''' was an astronomical object<ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Upell system/Legends|eponymous star system]], a part of the [[Agarix sector/Legends|Agarix sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> After the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]], following the [[Battle of Ithor|devastation]] of their homeworld, [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], sought to a new homeworld. Many of the survivors built colonies on [[Öetrago/Legends|Öetrago]], Upell, [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]<ref name="EA" /> and, eventually, [[Borao]].<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Upell was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it in grid square K-18.<ref name="EA" />
